mission: Read-only post-model audit of the frozen R3 economic outputs. No factor discovery, fitting, model selection, prediction regeneration, threshold change, or portfolio-rule optimization is permitted.

canonical_access.allowed: Read-only ETF minute bars only for accepted frozen R3 trades and their frozen entry-to-horizon intervals.

required_checks: same candidate selected with conflicting directions
same candidate selected with conflicting economic outcomes
dedup_audit.representative_rule: For a primary unique trade, require identical frozen entry, horizon, direction, ETF, target-hit flag, exit timestamp and gross return across duplicate records. If identical, retain the lexical-lowest seed record only for deduplicated economic summaries; otherwise stop invalid.

target_hit_timing_audit.time_end: frozen actual exit timestamp for target hits

BASELINE_FROZEN.definition: Use frozen R3 gross return and exact target execution convention without modification.

TARGET_EXIT_HAIRCUT_5BPS.definition: For target-hit trades, realized exit price equals frozen target price multiplied by 0.9995; timeout trades remain frozen. Then subtract the same frozen 10bps/20bps round-trip costs.

TARGET_EXIT_HAIRCUT_10BPS.definition: For target-hit trades, realized exit price equals frozen target price multiplied by 0.9990; timeout trades remain frozen. Then subtract the same frozen 10bps/20bps round-trip costs.

NEXT_VALID_MINUTE_OPEN_AFTER_HIT.definition: For target-hit trades, execute at the open of the next valid ETF minute strictly after the frozen first-hit minute. If no valid next minute exists at or before the frozen horizon, use the frozen timeout exit. Do not search or optimize another price.

POSITIVE_VOLUME_HIT_REQUIRED.definition: A target hit is eligible only when the frozen first-hit ETF minute is valid and has finite volume > 0. If ineligible, use the frozen timeout exit; do not scan for a later hit.

stress_evaluation.portfolio_rule: For deduplicated chronological stress, preserve the frozen accepted trade timestamps and reject no additional trades. This is an audit of already accepted trades, not a new signal selection.

subgroup_audit.missing_dimension_policy: Use the semantically equivalent existing column and document the mapping; do not infer a missing session from future data.

methods: Resample five FINAL_AUDIT blocks with replacement; keep all seed records within each sampled block.
Resample natural decision weeks with replacement on the primary-trade-deduplicated ledger.
Resample primary unique trades with replacement.
For learned minus strongest null, resample FINAL_AUDIT blocks, not block-by-seed rows.
required_outputs: learned minus strongest-null net10 block-cluster CI
learned minus strongest-null lift block-cluster CI

decision_rules.STOP_R3_DATA_OR_IMPLEMENTATION_INVALID: Any frozen input mismatch, conflicting duplicate outcome, timestamp/unit failure, target after horizon, Confirmation read, canonical write, repo code change, missing mandatory artifact, or audit computation failure.
decision_rules.STOP_R3_DUPLICATE_INFLATION_MATERIAL: Primary unique trade count is below 100, or deduplicated baseline median net10 is not positive, or duplicate handling materially reverses the sign of the frozen economic result.
decision_rules.STOP_R3_EXECUTION_ASSUMPTION_FRAGILE: Deduplicated 10bps target-haircut median net10 or deduplicated next-valid-minute-open median net10 is not positive, or execution stress reveals invalid/missing minute mappings.
decision_rules.STOP_R3_CLUSTER_UNCERTAINTY_NOT_ROBUST: Final-block clustered baseline net10 CI lower bound is not above zero, learned-minus-strongest-null block-cluster net10 CI lower bound is not above zero, or block/ETF concentration exceeds frozen limits.
decision_rules.PASS_R3_ECONOMIC_IMPLEMENTATION_AUDIT_CL: All integrity, deduplication, execution-stress, clustered-uncertainty, and concentration gates pass.

interpretation.pass_only_authorizes: Consider one separately pre-registered two-stage R4 architecture study on fresh blocks.
interpretation.failure_only_authorizes: Implementation-only economic recomputation from frozen R3 predictions; no model or factor retraining.

forbidden: label, horizon, ETF mapping, cost or target change
